titre: Devoir de contrôle n°2 - Anglais (3ème année secondaire)

exercices.enonce:
TEXT
Education is the most powerful weapon we can use to change the world. A country cannot develop if its people are not educated. Education does not only teach us how to read, write and calculate; it also teaches us how to think, to respect others and to become good citizens. An educated population can build a strong economy, fight poverty and solve problems in a peaceful way. This is why the richest and most advanced countries are those that invest the most in schools and universities. Sadly, in some parts of the world, millions of children, especially girls, still cannot go to school because of poverty, war or old traditions. Giving every child access to education is not only a duty; it is the key to a better future for all humanity.

I. READING COMPREHENSION (8 marks)
1) Why is education described as "the most powerful weapon"?   (2 marks)
2) What does education teach us, apart from reading and writing?   (2 marks)
3) Why do the richest countries invest the most in education?   (2 marks)
4) Why can some children not go to school, according to the text?   (2 marks)

II. LANGUAGE (6 marks)
1) Give the superlative: Education is ______ (powerful) weapon to change the world.   (1,5 marks)
2) Put into the passive: "Education can change the world."   (2 marks)
3) Complete with a relative pronoun (who / which): The countries ______ invest in education develop faster.   (1,5 marks)
4) Give the opposite of "educated" = ______.   (1 mark)

III. WRITING (6 marks)
"Why is education important for a country?" Write a paragraph (about 10 lines) giving at least two reasons, with examples. Use linkers.
